name: Marshall Machines Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Marshall Machines Ltd is in the business of developing, manufacturing, and marketing Machine Tool Equipment[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
MML began with manufacturing precision bench and heavy-duty lathes and now operates in a single segment focused on machine tool equipment. The company develops and markets advanced CNC machines (single, double, and four-spindle), automated robotic solutions, and Industry 4.0-enabled products such as Smart Correct Gauging Stations and its proprietary IoTQ suite of intelligent machines. It also offers comprehensive after-sales service as part of its solutions-focused business model.
